components.summary: Public lazy API, CLI dispatch with summary/--json output, and the fuel-cell example
responsibilities: Expose the native API through literal lazy owner exports
Dispatch CLI leaves to qualification, mesh, blueprint and revision owners; print a short summary by default and the full report with --json
Construct the packaged fuel-cell example without adding domain semantics
side_effects: Read declared CLI inputs; print a summary or the full JSON report

components.summary: Shared contracts, reports, status and semantic execution
responsibilities: Derive required Guards from claim semantics and claim assertion kinds and validate shared contract shapes
Execute native Event, Agent, Space, Resource, Causal, Conflict and Norm semantics, including event preconditions and causal constraints
Keep shared ledgers, reports and status aggregation
side_effects: Read declared mapping files (YAML only when PyYAML is installed) and emit JSON only when requested

components.summary: Seven structural Guards and their native family oracle catalog
responsibilities: Run the seven named structural Guard checks, including event preconditions and causal constraints, with shared errors and ledgers
Maintain native good cases and protected failure-class oracles without author-supervision proof
side_effects: Return structural results; explicit family check executes its finite native cases

components.summary: Unit qualification that runs the derived Guards and checks the claim assertions against the model
responsibilities: Qualify a unit by executing its derived Guard obligations structurally and semantically
Evaluate each claim.asserts row against the world model; a false row fails the claim, an unresolved row is a gap, and a claim without assertions is not bound (gap)
Keep structural status, semantic status and provider availability separate
Expose the run_worldguard kernel through one qualification owner
side_effects: Execute selected native Guards and return a bounded report

components.summary: Model mesh ownership, handoffs and predictive depth
responsibilities: Validate model authority, ports, handoffs, freshness and graph structure
Run per-node native qualification with complete per-variable/timepoint predictive coverage; a node claim that is false or not bound to its model fails or gaps the mesh
Report predictive gaps and the predictive license from one fresh run
state: Mesh and coverage fingerprints carried in immutable mesh reports
side_effects: Execute declared native mesh nodes and emit in-memory evidence

components.summary: WorldBlueprint hierarchy, behavior cases, impact and trace (repository author tool, not in the skill)
responsibilities: Validate hierarchical world elements and typed input/output/dependency bindings
Require one current binding for every role an element declares and derive claim contributors from the declared output lineage
Execute actual behavior cases and the selected external test and evidence records
Answer affected impact and reverse trace from one current qualified blueprint
state: Blueprint identities and binding content hashes
side_effects: Read declared evidence files; execute explicit behavior/test bindings; return reports

components.summary: Task-local prediction, reversible revision and fact transactions
responsibilities: Freeze prediction before observation, recording the model file sha256, and compare declared world coverage against that frozen record
Run the candidate mesh once and bind independent original and holdout observations to candidate revisions
Preview subordinate four-valued fact transactions and activate only against current evidence
state: Immutable prediction, observation, revision and fact-snapshot values
side_effects: Return candidate activation or rollback results without an implicit persistent store

components.summary: Native template registry, exact selection and instance construction
responsibilities: Select zero, one or many native template fragments with explicit ownership
Compose fragments, resolve typed slots (including the claim assertions) and validate native Guard/mesh routes
Report construction only; a built contract still runs through run_worldguard or run_model_mesh
state: Built-in template registry and immutable manifests
side_effects: Construct deterministic in-memory native contract scaffolding

components.summary: CI on every push and publication of one CI-checked source
responsibilities: Run the test suite, FlowGuard release check and skill install check on every push
Check source/version/changelog identity, wait for CI success on the exact SHA, and create the stable tag and Release at that commit
side_effects: CI is read-only; an explicit release commit or manual workflow publishes with GitHub token

components.summary: Skill installer and blueprint fixture refresh
responsibilities: Install the skill and copy the worldguard package into its runtime directory; check an installed copy
Regenerate the blueprint test fixtures from their raw inputs
side_effects: install replaces the target skill copy; check and dry-run modes are read-only

components.summary: Portable skill launcher and the references it serves
responsibilities: Run the installed runtime copy when present, otherwise the repository package, without writing bytecode
Keep contract and reporting instructions aligned with the CLI
side_effects: Run only the native WorldGuard CLI
